title: Service search empty query
action: Tap the magnifying-glass icon in the catalogue header.
observation: The empty search lists services, but many names and time estimates display raw translation keys.

title: Service search Report matches
action: Search for Report, matching the repository's positive-search fixture.
observation: Report returns exactly two cards: REPORT_LOST_PASSPORT and REPORT_LOST_IDENTITY_CARD. Labels and time estimates are untranslated keys.

title: Open a matched service search result
action: Search Report → REPORT_LOST_PASSPORT.
observation: Selecting REPORT_LOST_PASSPORT from search opened the Passport Online Report entry page. No report was submitted.

title: Service search with no matches
action: Replace Report with test, the repository's negative-search fixture.
observation: The query test leaves no service cards visible. No no-results message is displayed.

title: Clearing service search restores the list
action: Clear the no-match query.
observation: Clearing test restores the unfiltered service list. Raw translation keys remain visible.
